# Stress result (`stress-result` v1)

P&L of a desk under a scenario, by book.

**Group:** Market risk · **Mnemonic:** `STR` · **Identifiers:** `STR-…` in `resultId`

Open one with `STR <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: stress-result
version: 1
description: "P&L of a desk under a scenario, by book."
match: { kind: stress-result, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Market risk · Stress result, id: $.resultId }
strip:
  - { label: Scenario, bind: $.scenarioName }
  - { label: "P&L", bind: $.pnl, fmt: signed0, tone: sign, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Limit, bind: $.limit, fmt: compact }
panels:
  - id: books
    kind: hbar
    title: "P&L by book"
    key: F2
    rows: $.byBook
    label: book
    value: pnl
    fmt: signed0
    tone: sign
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.scenario, 'stress-scenario')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
